name: Unlock User Code
description: Sent when a user selects Unlock on the Sign In page to provide a code that is used to unlock the account.
subject: Your account unlock code: ${token}
body:
Account unlock code

Dear ${user.name},

A request was made to unlock your ${PRODUCT_NAME} account. If you submitted this request, copy the code below into the prompt in ${PRODUCT_NAME} to verify your identity.

Unlock code

${token}

  • This code expires as soon as it is used, or on ${expires}.
  • If you did not make this request, contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
